findings: Original cache/models loaded through a package namespace without executing GUI-importing __init__. CacheManager subclass overrides only cache_dir to isolate writes in TemporaryDirectory. Installed pydantic2.14.1, not pinned upstream dependency environment.
After valid save, removing hashes_src then saving new phash settings retains old hashes.json while metadata changes to phash. Confirmed directly; caller pipeline behavior still needs review.
Replacing cached hashes.json with malformed text does not invalidate load or load_results, which check existence and parse other files only. copy_hashes_to copies corrupt text successfully.
ProjectionResult accepts two file paths with one one-dimensional point. ClusterResult accepts out-of-range member99 for one file. Semantic shape/index validation absent from these models.

Cache identity uses raw folder string MD5; no file content, size, modification time, recipe version or source manifest validation inside CacheManager. Writes are separate direct overwrites without transaction.
GUI constants include ppm/pgm/hdr/pic and mpg/mpeg that C++ scanner omits; visible format lists differ from scan behavior.
HashSettings constrains size4..32, unlike CLI2..1024. Console entry points to visualize:main while wheel packages list only sift_viz; packaging concern source-only, wheel not built.
